pool.text: Using Sophie Germain's algebraic identity, \( N = 3^4 + 4 \cdot 2^4 \) factors into two positive integers greater than \( 1 \): \( N = u \cdot v \) with \( u < v \). What is the value of the smaller factor \( u \)?

pool.educational_aim: Master Olympiad Algebra, Vieta & Inequalities via authentic Olympiad, NSMO of KSA, and KAUST KMC problem-solving (medium tier).
pool.sol: To cancel \( x \) in the AM-GM product, split the reciprocal term into two equal halves: \( h(x) = x^2 + \frac{1}{x} + \frac{1}{x} \). By 3-term AM-GM, \( h(x) \ge 3\sqrt[3]{1x^2 \cdot \frac{1}{x} \cdot \frac{1}{x}} = 3\sqrt[3]{1} = 3 \), with equality achieved at \( x = 1 \).
hints: Naive 2-term AM-GM leaves \( \sqrt{x} \) uncancelled; split \( \frac{2}{x} = \frac{1}{x} + \frac{1}{x} \).
Apply 3-term AM-GM to \( x^2,\; \frac{1}{x},\; \frac{1}{x} \) so \( x^2 \cdot x^{-1} \cdot x^{-1} = 1 \).
Verify equality holds at \( 1x^2 = \frac{1}{x} \iff x = 1 \), giving minimum \( 3 \).
